name: model-picker
title: Model Picker
description: A searchable list of AI models that opens from a composer chip or a settings-rail row: Featured and All groups, each row an icon tile, name, one-line description and optional New or Hot badge, with a check on the model in use.

meta.use_when: You let people choose which AI model runs a generation and each model needs a one-line description to choose by, such as the model chip in a composer or the model row in a studio rail
